label: The stance's demand for reasons why is uniform in the feature
paraphrase: P3 of the parity argument, the consistency norm, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: any two facts agreeing on the feature k are alike required, or alike not required, to have a reason why they obtain. Relative to k: the same stance can be uniform in one feature and not in another, and nothing here says which feature is the right ground of a demand.
